changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on the Modwerk base: a barber-pole flanger on the send bus.
Send each track from its SEND page (AMP twice); choose FLANGER on SEND FX (DELAY twice on the FX track, FUNC + A).
Five controls, SPD to LPF, lockable on the FX track; the sound is Send FX's FLANGER, unchanged.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build.
